description: Composite of six TEM panels from annealed Fe–28Mn–9Al-1.2C-xCr strips (550 °C, 5 h), all imaging austenite. (a)–(d) are bright-field (BF) images, each with a 500 nm scale bar, yellow arrows marking dislocations, and a selected-area diffraction pattern (SADP) inset. (a) 0Cr strip: SADP indexed [001]γ+[001]κ with reflections (020),(220),(200),(100),(110),(010),(000), i.e. {100}-type κ-carbide superlattice. (b) 3Cr strip: SADP along [011]γ with (000),(1̄11),(111),(200). (c) 6Cr strip: SADP along [1̄12]γ+[1̄12]κ with (000),(1̄11),(111),(311),(220),(1̄10),(201). (d) 9Cr strip: SADP along [001]γ with (000),(010),(110),(100), no superlattice. (e) dark-field (DF) image of 0Cr taken along (01̄0)κ, 200 nm scale bar, fine dense speckled κ-carbides. (f) DF image of 9Cr along (1̄14)Cr23C6, 500 nm scale bar, one coarse Cr23C6 particle with SADP (000),(1̄31),(311),(220), zone [1̄14]Cr23C6. Together the panels show that κ-carbide superlattice intensity decreases with Cr content, vanishing at 9Cr where coarse Cr23C6 forms instead.

subfigures.description: BF TEM image of annealed 0Cr strip, 500 nm scale bar, high dislocation density (yellow arrows). SADP inset indexed [001]γ+[001]κ shows many {100}-type superlattice reflections (100),(010),(110),(020),(200),(220),(000).
BF TEM image of annealed 3Cr strip, 500 nm scale bar, dislocations arrowed. SADP inset along [011]γ with (000),(1̄11),(111),(200); superlattice reflections very weak/absent.
BF TEM image of annealed 6Cr strip, 500 nm scale bar, dislocations arrowed. SADP inset along [1̄12]γ+[1̄12]κ with (000),(1̄11),(111),(311),(220),(1̄10),(201).
BF TEM image of annealed 9Cr strip, 500 nm scale bar, dislocations arrowed. SADP inset along [001]γ with (000),(010),(110),(100); no superlattice reflections.
DF TEM image of annealed 0Cr strip taken along (01̄0)κ, 200 nm scale bar, showing dense fine speckled κ-carbides (label 'κ-carbides').
DF TEM image of annealed 9Cr strip taken along (1̄14)Cr23C6, 500 nm scale bar, showing one coarse Cr23C6 particle (label 'Cr23C6') with corresponding SADP (000),(1̄31),(311),(220), zone [1̄14]Cr23C6.

observations.observation: Panels (a)-(d) are BF TEM images of annealed 0Cr, 3Cr, 6Cr and 9Cr strips, each with a 500 nm scale bar and yellow arrows marking dislocations.
The SADP inset of (a) is indexed to [001]γ+[001]κ and contains {100}-type reflections (100),(010),(110) alongside (020),(200),(220),(000).
The SADP inset of (c) is indexed to [1̄12]γ+[1̄12]κ with reflections (000),(1̄11),(111),(311),(220),(1̄10),(201).
The SADP inset of (d) is indexed to [001]γ with only (000),(010),(110),(100) visible, showing no κ-carbide superlattice reflections.
Panel (e) is a DF image labelled 'κ-carbides', taken along (01̄0)κ, with a 200 nm scale bar and a dense speckled contrast of fine precipitates.
Panel (f) is a DF image labelled 'Cr23C6', taken along (1̄14)Cr23C6, 500 nm scale bar, showing a single coarse carbide particle.
The caption states the panels are TEM images of austenite in Fe–28Mn–9Al-1.2C-xCr annealed at 550 °C for 5 h.
The caption states that after 550 °C/5 h annealing, 0Cr strip still shows clear κ-carbide superlattices whose intensity increases, while those in 3Cr and 6Cr SADPs are still very weak.
The caption states no κ-carbide superlattice is found in the 9Cr SADP, and only Cr23C6 carbides with a width of about 200 nm are observed (panel f).

The citing text states the dislocation density in austenite of annealed Cr-containing strips is obviously reduced versus as-cast Cr-containing strips, but still higher than that of annealed 0Cr strip.
The citing text states that in annealed 0Cr strip more κ-carbides are present with an average diameter of 14 nm, whereas as-cast 0Cr strip averages 8 nm.
None of the panels prints numerical axis values; the only numeric scales are the 500 nm and 200 nm scale bars and the printed diffraction indices.
